_meta.source: Computed styles read live in the signed-in app (built-in browser pane, 1440x900, dark theme), 2026-10-17. States reached with the real keyboard or pointer.

menu-item-focus-visible.how: header Menu button focused, Enter, ArrowDown

button3d-blue-hover.how: real pointer over the home 'Start' button (Chrome)
button3d-blue-hover.--button3d-hover-tint: (unset in Chrome; Safari paints var(--button3d-hover-tint) on ::after instead of the opacity)

text-area-koji-focused-filled.how: clicked the /koji/ prompt and typed a question (not sent)
text-area-koji-focused-filled.element: textarea (placeholder 'Something else…') in the glass prompt pill
text-area-koji-focused-filled.focus ring: none on the textarea or pill (outline style none); focus is shown by the caret only
